blocks.text: Greenhouses combine structure validation, irrigation, farmland preparation, planting, harvesting and optional accelerated growth. Correct material geometry alone does not guarantee that every crop can survive in every position.

rows: Build or assemble the correct greenhouse tier and leave its growing cells available.
Prepare the required dirt/grass underneath the crop positions. Automatic farmland and water placement must be enabled and permitted by protection checks.
Supply seeds compatible with that tier. Basic/Advanced reserve their first four input slots for construction materials; Flawless can use all fourteen inputs for seeds.
Place a chest directly outside the controller for seed import and produce export, or use internal storage. Its side mode must allow the requested direction.
Supply FE and suitable CO₂. Watch for pending output, a disabled side, Pause, or redstone before adding more fuel.
Allow ordinary crop light/survival rules. A greenhouse does not invent a valid harvest contract for an arbitrary third-party plant.
Can also grow outside a greenhouse.
Requires at least Advanced tier for greenhouse planting.

blocks.text: Gas Lanterns supply CO₂ to Basic and Advanced structures; Flawless uses its correctly positioned CO₂ Generator. Carbon changes growth intervals. Planting, growth, harvest, water and farmland each have separate energy/settings controls.
